market_question: Will Solana dip to $20 by December 31, 2026?
reasoning: Solana currently trades near $220, so a drop to $20 represents a >90% crash, far worse than the 2022 bear market low (~$8). While crypto tail events are possible, the 13-month window makes such an extreme decline very unlikely. The market's 9.5% implied probability is inflated; I estimate the true chance at 2–3%, giving a substantial edge to 'No'.
evidence_points: Solana's current price is ~$220, meaning $20 is a 90%+ drop from current levels.
Historical all-time low was ~$8 during the 2022 crypto winter; a repeat of similar extremes within 13 months is low-probability.
Solana's large market cap (~$80B) and deep DeFi/NFT integration provide some floor against a total collapse.
